full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2079
11th Session
Meeting Number - 57
Federal
Daily Agenda
2082 Bhadra 5, Thursday
1:00 PM
1. Presentation of Committee Report
Honorable Chairperson Santosh Chalise of the Finance Committee will present the "Report of the Committee on the Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082".
2. Management Work
Honorable Minister for Industry, Commerce and Supplies, Damodar Bhandari will present a proposal to "Send the Industrial Property Bill, 2082 for clause-by-clause discussion to the relevant committee".
3. Honorable Minister for Physical Infrastructure and Transport, Devendra Dahal will present a proposal to "Send the Ship (Operation and Management) Bill, 2081, originating in the National Assembly, for clause-by-clause discussion to the relevant committee".
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
